decision.detector_scope: Frozen rapid-change detector: at least 7 alternating luminance transitions in a rolling second, connected support at least 64 pixels. Separate steady-detail-v1: small stationary two-state luma appearance, at least 6 transitions, bounded state and chroma errors, minimum dwell. Proposals are not semantic distraction labels.
limitations: No candidate does not mean distraction-free or safe.
